layers.authority: Balai Taman Nasional Wakatobi (national park office, Ministry of Forestry)
layers.process: Wakatobi National Park sells tickets online. Foreign visitors pay IDR 150,000 a person a day (about A$11.74, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, IDR 12,780 per A$1) and IDR 225,000 on holidays (about A$17.61). Activity tickets are extra: scuba diving IDR 25,000 a person a day (about A$1.96), snorkelling IDR 15,000 (about A$1.17) and fishing IDR 25,000 (about A$1.96). Boats pay too: a motor boat of 40 to 100 horsepower IDR 100,000 a day (about A$7.82) and a cruise yacht IDR 2,000,000 per unit a day (about A$156.49).

The park's site links a separate SIMAKSI (entry permit for specified activities) service, with ticket counters on Kaledupa, Tomia - Binongko and Wangi-Wangi. The permit rules themselves were not on the pages read.
